title: Monitoring Business Central Server Events in Event Viewer

facts.text: Business Central Server events are recorded in event channels specific to Business Central and the Windows Application log
Admin log includes events targeting end users and IT administrators indicating problems requiring action
Operational log includes ordinary operating events providing information for analysis and diagnosis
Debug log includes SQL tracing, service call traces, and AL function call traces
Debug logs are hidden and disabled by default in Event Viewer
Telemetry events in Common folder have IDs 700-716 in version 29
Diagnostic Trace Level configuration setting controls the lowest severity level of telemetry events recorded in the event log
